verdict.rationale: mParticle's own docs include a section titled "View and enforce your data quality", plus a separate "Ensure data quality" entry, so the product claims first-party enforcement. The pack contains only these headings, with no detail on how violating events are flagged, blocked, or quarantined. Missing for 10: documented schema or tracking-plan definition, documented flag/block/quarantine behavior for violating events, any detail beyond section titles, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, a tracking plan or schema is enforced — violating events get flagged, blocked, or quarantined instead of silently corrupting downstream data

citations.quote: View and enforce your data quality
